methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The objective of the Key Factors (Kf) methodology is to use these calibrated BES models, to support energy managers in determining the optimal building operation strategy in relation to both energy consumption and occupants comfort. The Key Factors (Kf) are those parameters of the operation strategy that influence the environmental and energy performance of the building. Examples include temperature set-point, lighting levels set-point, etc.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This research reviews some of these new approaches and proposes a novel integrated toolkit designed to assist energy managers at different stages of their activity relating to systematic energy management in buildings.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The focus of this paper is particularly centred on the applicability of the integrated toolkit in the building industry
